nodes.text: [i]Night. A small figure is awake in the dark, holding her blanket like a shield.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Wren
nodes.text: Garrick? Will you stay till I fall asleep?

nodes.speaker: Young Garrick
nodes.text: Is it the thing under the bed again?

nodes.speaker: Young Garrick
nodes.text: Then I'll make you something. A sword.

nodes.speaker: Young Garrick
nodes.text: A hero's sword makes the dark afraid of her.

nodes.speaker: Wren
nodes.text: Then I'll hold it very tight.
